about: Colour themes (Danylo, 18.11.2026; artboards 58-59). Web and Android copy this file into their tests unchanged and must build the same colours. Made by functions/scripts/theme-vectors.mjs; contract in CONTRACT.md, boards, Settings.

algorithm.scheme: DynamicScheme with variant TONAL_SPOT (spec 2021), contrast level 0, over five TonalPalette.fromHueAndChroma palettes (primary, secondary, tertiary, neutral, neutralVariant); light and dark from the same palettes
algorithm.presets: matcha, peach and sky are the fixed tables under presets: a client takes their light and dark roles as they are (palettes say how they were made)
algorithm.ownColour: seed = Hct.from(hue, 36, 50) as an ARGB colour, h = Hct.fromInt(seed).hue; palettes primary (h, 36), secondary (h, 16), tertiary (h + 60, 24), neutral (h, 8), neutralVariant (h, 10). With neutral 6 and 8 this is exactly SchemeTonalSpot.
algorithm.tolerance: each of red, green and blue within 1 of the file
algorithm.mainButton: primary; mainButtonNearestTier is its CIEDE2000 distance to the closest tier colour S-D (today's lavender: 9.6 light, 12.8 dark)

names.lavender: the default and today's look: each client's own hand-made colours, not built from a hue
names.phone: Android 12+: the phone's own wallpaper colours; the website and older Android show lavender
